text: This report is part of the City Manager's regular updates to Council on the City's COVID-19 response, recovery and rebuild actions. The information should be considered in the context of the pandemic, which is currently in a critical phase with an ongoing Emergency declared by the Provincial government until May 2021 at the earliest. The City Manager's October 2020 COVID-19 status report (EX17.1) identified that there were over 600 outstanding directives from Committees and City Council from the start of this Council term as tracked by the City Clerk's Office. Over the past year, as resources and capacity allow, staff have continued to address outstanding pre-pandemic directives from City Council.
